flow.name: assess_app-mcp-tool
flow.doc:name: MCP Tool: assess_app
flow.doc:description: MCP tool entry point for assessing a MuleSoft application's Java 17 upgrade readiness

mcp:tool-listener.name: assess_app
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: assess_app
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Assess a deployed MuleSoft application for Java 17 / Mule 4.9.x upgrade readiness. Returns the current runtime version, recommended change plan, and any warnings that require human review before submitting an upgrade job. Call this before start_upgrade.

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Response Sent
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'RESPONSE SENT | status=' ++ ((vars.httpStatus default 200) as String)]

flow.name: start_upgrade-mcp-tool
flow.doc:name: MCP Tool: start_upgrade
flow.doc:description: MCP tool entry point for submitting an approved Java 17 upgrade job

mcp:tool-listener.name: start_upgrade
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: start_upgrade
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Start an asynchronous Java 17 upgrade job for a MuleSoft application after the user has reviewed and approved the change plan from assess_app. Returns a jobId that can be polled with get_job_status to track progress (PROCESSING → COMMITTED → PR_OPEN → DEPLOYED).

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Response Sent
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'RESPONSE SENT | status=' ++ ((vars.httpStatus default 200) as String)]

flow.name: get_job_status-mcp-tool
flow.doc:name: MCP Tool: get_job_status
flow.doc:description: MCP tool entry point for retrieving the current status of an upgrade job

mcp:tool-listener.name: get_job_status
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: get_job_status
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Retrieve the current status of a platform migration job submitted by start_upgrade. Poll this tool until status reaches a terminal state: DEPLOYED (success), ROLLED_BACK, or any FAILED_* state — FAILED_ASSESS, FAILED_COMMIT, FAILED_CI, FAILED_DEPLOY, FAILED_INTERRUPTED (error — inspect the error field). Non-terminal (keep polling) states include PROCESSING, ASSESSING, COMMITTING, COMMITTED, PR_OPEN and DEPLOYING. MUNIT_FAILED is a non-terminal PAUSE that needs human action: the app's MUnit suite failed in CI (see the error field) and the job waits (retained ~30 days) until a human fixes the tests and CI reports a test success, which resumes it automatically. When status is PR_OPEN the prUrl field contains the GitHub pull request link. Honour the nextPollSeconds hint in the response as the suggested wait before polling again.

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Response Sent
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'RESPONSE SENT | status=' ++ ((vars.httpStatus default 200) as String)]

flow.name: reapply_job-mcp-tool
flow.doc:name: MCP Tool: reapply_job
flow.doc:description: MCP tool entry point for re-launching an upgrade from a previous job's inputs

mcp:tool-listener.name: reapply_job
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: reapply_job
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Re-launch a Java 17 upgrade for the SAME application using a previous job's stored inputs, re-assessed against the CURRENT compatibility matrix. Use this after the matrix was republished to cover a connector that was previously un-pinned, or to retry a MUNIT_FAILED / FAILED_* / CLOSED job without re-typing coordinates. Mints a NEW jobId (poll it with get_job_status) and opens a fresh pull request. The previous job's lock is released automatically before the relaunch.

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Response Sent
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'RESPONSE SENT | status=' ++ ((vars.httpStatus default 200) as String)]

flow.name: delete_job-mcp-tool
flow.doc:name: MCP Tool: delete_job
flow.doc:description: MCP tool entry point for deleting a job record and releasing its lock/index

mcp:tool-listener.name: delete_job
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: delete_job
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Admin / maintenance tool: permanently delete a migration job record, clear its branch-to-job index entry, and release the app's single-flight upgrade lock so the app can be upgraded again immediately. Use for test teardown or to unblock an app stuck behind a leftover lock. Returns { deleted, jobId, branchIndexCleared, lockReleased }. Deleting an unknown jobId returns an error. The upgrade lifecycle never deletes jobs on its own (they age out via the 30-day TTL); this is an explicit manual action.

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Response Sent
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'RESPONSE SENT | status=' ++ ((vars.httpStatus default 200) as String)]

flow.name: upgrade_parent_pom-mcp-tool
flow.doc:name: MCP Tool: upgrade_parent_pom
flow.doc:description: MCP tool entry point for upgrading a shared parent/BOM pom's connector versions

mcp:tool-listener.name: upgrade_parent_pom
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: upgrade_parent_pom
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Upgrade a SHARED parent/BOM pom.xml so the connector versions it manages meet the Java 17 compatibility matrix, then open a pull request against the parent/BOM repository. Use this to fix the connectorGaps reported by assess_app for apps that inherit connector versions from a parent/BOM (assess only pins connectors already versioned in the app pom; the rest must be fixed here at the source). Only connectors the parent already MANAGES are touched — none are invented. Provide repoUrl OR owner+repo; pomPath defaults to "pom.xml" and branch defaults to the repo's default branch. Returns { jobId, status, upgraded, prUrl, prNumber, branchName, jiraTicketId, jiraUrl, edits }. Track progress with get_job_status(jobId): status is PR_OPEN when a PR was opened, or NO_CHANGE when the pom already met the matrix.

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Response Sent
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'RESPONSE SENT | status=' ++ ((vars.httpStatus default 200) as String)]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- ((vars.requestBody.orgId default p('anypoint.defaultOrgId')) default '') as String]
set-variable.doc:name: PV SET vfyOrgId

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- (payload.data default []) map ((e) -> (e.name default '') as String)]
set-variable.doc:name: PV SET envList

when.expression: #[not (((vars.envList default []) map upper($)) contains upper(vars.environment default ''))]
when.doc:name: env not in org

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN env not found
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'env not found | env=' ++ (vars.environment default '?') ++ ' | orgId=' ++ (vars.vfyOrgId default '?') ++ ' | valid=' ++ ((vars.envList default []) joinBy ',')]

raise-error.doc:name: RAISE VALIDATION:ENV_NOT_FOUND
raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'Environment "' ++ (vars.environment default '?') ++ '" was not found in this Anypoint organization. Valid environments: ' ++ (if (isEmpty(vars.envList default [])) '(none)' else ((vars.envList default []) joinBy ', ')) ++ '. Please provide a valid environment name.']

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN env check skipped
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'env validation SKIPPED (anypoint lookup failed: ' ++ (error.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default '') ++ ') — proceeding without env pre-check']
